{{Quote|Today I hold the spear held by Chirpa and our esteemed ancestral leaders. And today, I take a wife, the lovely Kneesaa.&raquo;''<br />''&laquo;Today I take the hand of Wicket, my handsome husband. Today I listen to the wisdom of the trees who guided us to love and live in their shade.|translated=1|An excerpt of the wedding vows|<ref name="TEGAS">[[The Essential Guide to Alien Species (real-world book)|''The Essential Guide to Alien Species'']]</ref>}}
The '''Wedding of [[Wicket Wystri Warrick/Legends|Wicket Wystri Warrick]] and [[Kneesaa a Jari Kintaka/Legends|Kneesaa a Jari Kintaka]]''' took place sometime after the [[Battle of Endor/Legends|Battle of Endor]], shortly after the death of [[Chief/Legends|Chief]] [[Chirpa/Legends|Chirpa]].<ref name="TEGAS" />

The ceremony doubled as [[Kneesaa a Jari Kintaka/Legends|Kneesaa's]] induction as the new chief of [[Bright Tree Village/Legends|Bright Tree Village]].<ref name="TEGAS" />

==Behind the scenes==
In [[1995]], ''[[The Essential Guide to Characters]]'' hinted that Wicket would replace Chirpa as chief of Bright Tree Village.<ref name="TEGC">''[[The Essential Guide to Characters]]</ref> But the [[2001]] [[The Essential Guide to Alien Species (real-world book)|''The Essential Guide to Alien Species'']] indicated that Kneesaa became the new ruler<ref name="TEGAS" /> (as it was originally implied she would be in [[Ewoks (1985) 2|''Ewoks'' (1985) 2]]).<ref name="Ewoks">''[[Ewoks (1985) 2 ''Ewoks'' (1985) 2[[</ref> However, Wicket's [[Memory bank/Legends|databank]] entry confirms that the couple co-ruled the village together, although it does not specify if Wicket was inducted at the same time as Kneesaa.<ref name="DB">{{DB|character|wicketwwarrick|Warrick, Wicket W.}}</ref>
